reference/agent-api/cancel-a-run.description: Cancel a queued or running Agent run.

reference/agent-api/list-run-events.description: List stored Agent run events or replay them as server-sent events.

reference/monitors/create-a-monitor.title: Create a monitor
reference/monitors/create-a-monitor.description:
Creates a new Monitor to run recurring Exa searches on a schedule.

Monitors automatically execute your search query on a recurring schedule and deliver results to your webhook endpoint with automatic deduplication:

- **Date-based filtering** only fetches content since the last run

- **Semantic deduplication** tracks previous outputs to surface only new developments

The response includes a `webhookSecret` that is only returned once at creation time. Store it securely for webhook signature verification.

reference/monitors/list-monitors.title: List monitors
reference/monitors/list-monitors.description: Lists all monitors for the authenticated team. Supports filtering by status and cursor-based pagination.

reference/monitors/get-a-monitor.title: Get a monitor
reference/monitors/get-a-monitor.description: Retrieves a single monitor by its ID.

reference/monitors/update-a-monitor.title: Update a monitor
reference/monitors/update-a-monitor.description: Updates an existing monitor. All fields are optional. For `search`, you can send a partial object containing only the fields you want to change. Set `trigger` to `null` to remove the schedule.

reference/monitors/delete-a-monitor.title: Delete a monitor
reference/monitors/delete-a-monitor.description: Deletes a monitor. This cannot be undone.

reference/monitors/trigger-a-monitor.title: Trigger a monitor
reference/monitors/trigger-a-monitor.description: Triggers a run immediately, regardless of the schedule. Works for monitors with status `active` or `paused`.

reference/monitors/batch-monitors.title: Batch action on monitors
reference/monitors/batch-monitors.description:
Perform a batch action on monitors matching the provided filters.

Supported actions:
- **delete**: Permanently remove matching monitors
- **pause**: Pause matching monitors
- **unpause**: Unpause matching monitors

Use `dry_run: true` (the default) to preview which monitors would be affected before performing the action. Results are paginated via the `limit` parameter; loop until `has_more` is `false` to process all matching monitors.

reference/monitors/runs/list-runs.title: List runs
reference/monitors/runs/list-runs.description: Lists all runs for a monitor with cursor-based pagination. Runs are returned in reverse chronological order.

reference/monitors/runs/get-a-run.title: Get a run
reference/monitors/runs/get-a-run.description: Retrieves a single run by its ID, including the full output if the run is completed.

reference/answer.title: Answer
reference/answer.description:
Get an LLM answer to a question informed by Exa search results. `/answer` performs an Exa search and uses an LLM to generate either:
1. A direct answer for specific queries. (i.e. "What is the capital of France?" would return "Paris")
2. A detailed summary with citations for open-ended queries (i.e. "What is the state of ai in healthcare?" would return a summary with citations to relevant sources)

The response includes both the generated answer and the sources used to create it. The endpoint also supports streaming (as `stream=True`), which will return tokens as they are generated.

Alternatively, you can use the OpenAI compatible [chat completions interface](https://exa.ai/docs/integrations/openai-sdk#answer).

websets/api/websets/create-a-webset.title: Create a webset
websets/api/websets/create-a-webset.description:
Creates a new Webset with optional search, import, and enrichment configurations. The Webset will automatically begin processing once created.

You can specify an `externalId` to reference the Webset with your own identifiers for easier integration.

websets/api/websets/get-a-webset.title: Get a webset
websets/api/websets/get-a-webset.description:
Returns a Webset by `id` or `externalId`, including its status, searches, imports, enrichments, and monitors.

Pass `expand=items` to include up to the first 100 items in the response.

websets/api/websets/update-a-webset.title: Update a webset
websets/api/websets/update-a-webset.description: Updates the `title` or `metadata` of a Webset. Searches, imports, and enrichments are managed through their own endpoints.

websets/api/websets/delete-a-webset.title: Delete a webset
websets/api/websets/delete-a-webset.description:
Deletes a Webset.

Once deleted, the Webset and all its Items will no longer be available.

websets/api/websets/preview-a-webset.title: Preview a webset
websets/api/websets/preview-a-webset.description:
Preview how a search query will be decomposed before creating a webset. This endpoint performs the same query analysis that happens during webset creation, allowing you to see the detected entity type, generated search criteria, and available enrichment columns in advance.

Use this to help users understand how their search will be interpreted before committing to a full webset creation.

websets/api/websets/cancel-a-running-web.title: Cancel a running webset
websets/api/websets/cancel-a-running-web.description:
Cancels all operations being performed on a Webset.

Any enrichment or search will be stopped and the Webset will be marked as `idle`.

websets/api/websets/list-all-websets.title: List all websets
websets/api/websets/list-all-websets.description:
Returns a list of Websets.

You can paginate through the results using the `cursor` parameter.

You can filter results using the `search` parameter to find Websets by ID, external ID, or title.

websets/api/websets/items/delete-an-item.title: Delete an item
websets/api/websets/items/delete-an-item.description:
Deletes an Item from the Webset.

This will cancel any enrichment process for it.

websets/api/websets/items/list-all-items.title: List all items for a webset
websets/api/websets/items/list-all-items.description:
Returns a list of Webset Items.

You can paginate through the Items using the `cursor` parameter.

websets/api/websets/searches/create-a-se.title: Create a search
websets/api/websets/searches/create-a-se.description:
Creates a new Search for the Webset.

The default behavior is to reuse the previous Search results and evaluate them against the new criteria.

websets/api/websets/searches/cancel-a-ru.title: Cancel a running search
websets/api/websets/searches/cancel-a-ru.description:
Cancels a currently running Search.

You can cancel all searches at once by using the `websets/:webset/cancel` endpoint.

websets/api/websets/enrichments/create-a.title: Create an enrichment
websets/api/websets/enrichments/create-a.description: Create an Enrichment for a Webset.

websets/api/websets/enrichments/get-an-e.title: Get an enrichment
websets/api/websets/enrichments/get-an-e.description: Returns an Enrichment configured on a Webset, including its status, description, format, and options.

websets/api/websets/enrichments/update-a.title: Update an enrichment
websets/api/websets/enrichments/update-a.description: Update an Enrichment configuration for a Webset.

websets/api/websets/enrichments/delete-a.title: Delete an enrichment
websets/api/websets/enrichments/delete-a.description: When deleting an Enrichment, any running enrichments will be canceled and all existing `enrichment_result` generated by this Enrichment will no longer be available.

websets/api/websets/enrichments/cancel-a.title: Cancel a running enrichment
websets/api/websets/enrichments/cancel-a.description: All running enrichments will be canceled. You can not resume an Enrichment after it has been canceled.

websets/api/imports/create-an-import.title: Create an import
websets/api/imports/create-an-import.description:
Creates a new import to upload your data into Websets. Imports can be used to:

- **Enrich**: Enhance your data with additional information using our AI-powered enrichment engine
- **Search**: Query your data using Websets' agentic search with natural language filters
- **Exclude**: Prevent duplicate or already known results from appearing in your searches

Once the import is created, you can upload your data to the returned `uploadUrl` until `uploadValidUntil` (by default 1 hour).

websets/api/imports/list-imports.title: List imports
websets/api/imports/list-imports.description: Lists all imports for the Webset.

websets/api/monitors/create-a-monitor.title: Create a Websets monitor
websets/api/monitors/create-a-monitor.description:
Creates a new `Monitor` to continuously keep your Websets updated with fresh data.

Monitors automatically run on your defined schedule to ensure your Websets stay current without manual intervention:

- **Find new content**: Execute `search` operations to discover fresh items matching your criteria
- **Update existing content**: Run `refresh` operations to update items contents and enrichments
- **Automated scheduling**: Configure `cron` expressions and `timezone` for precise scheduling control

websets/api/monitors/list-monitors.title: List Websets monitors
websets/api/monitors/list-monitors.description: Lists all monitors for the Webset.

websets/api/monitors/runs/list-monitor-r.title: List monitor runs
websets/api/monitors/runs/list-monitor-r.description: Lists all runs for the Monitor.
